name: P2COS
summary: Local-first desktop app for finding prospects, tracking outreach and moving them through a pipeline, with optional local AI; Windows and Mac, early access.
best_for: owner-operators and small teams who want a local-first desktop tool for finding prospects, tracking outreach and moving them through a pipeline, and who accept an early product
skip_if: you need a web or mobile CRM, you cannot run unsigned Mac software, or you want a mature product with a track record and a tool we have tested ourselves
honest_knock: It is an Early Access product at version 0.6.0, and the Mac builds are not signed or notarized, so you may need to override macOS warnings. The software needs a paid licence, and several support features are listed as coming soon.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-11 on p2cos.com/pricing, US dollars) P2COS sells three plans. Starter is $19.99 a month for solo operators, with 1 business setup. Pro is $39.99 a month with up to 2 business setups and the discovery, research and outreach workflows. Power is $69.99 a month with up to 3 business setups and the commercial workflow, documents and analytics. Annual standard prices are $199.99, $399.99 and $699.99. The page shows Early Access discounts of 70%, 35% and 25%, which bring the monthly prices to $6.00, $25.99 and $52.49 with a code applied at checkout; those are Early Access prices, so plan on the standard price later. A separate Founder Lifetime licence costs $399.99 once, is limited to the first 500 verified buyers and covers desktop software, updates and major upgrades; the page says charges from third-party services, email or model providers are not included, and it offers a 14-day full refund on Founder Lifetime only. Checkout runs through Lemon Squeezy. A free account is available, but the page says a valid licence is needed to use the software. We did not open checkout, so the tax added is not known.
